name: se2
description: Traverse graph-first Learn, Idea, Feature Plan, Implement, and live session Audit workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Plan Feature Sets and implement them through verified workers and optional support.
interface.longDescription: SE2 is an experimental issue-first, graph-first plugin with explicit durable-context, Idea capture, Feature Plan Set creation, GitHub-Feature-to-PR implementation, and live session Audit entry points. Learn performs only authorized local-repository context changes and has no external dependency preflight. Idea publishes hosted Ideas by default through G, with local preview as an opt-in. Feature analyzes one or more source issues, uses optional bounded read-only analysts and an independent critic when delegation is available, presents one consolidated batch of material questions, converges genuinely distinct sibling Features with stable Feature identities and acceptance criteria, keeps Feature-level dependencies separate from same-parent Macro Task dependencies, and publishes every parent Feature, local child Tasks, and verified set registry by default without creating a container or deriving technical execution units. Idea, Feature, and Implement share one portable-content safety gate immediately before every hosted write; SE2 owns semantic projection while G owns transport and readback. Implement consumes authoritative Feature Plan Sets and verified sibling/Macro projections, derives technical execution units in its control plane, coordinates a Sol/medium orchestrator with one adaptive Sol Feature Worker, isolated worktree, branch, and PR per implementation-eligible Feature, binds local Feature/Macro evidence to one final exact HEAD, and derives one closing set per Feature containing only that parent and its associated Macro Tasks. Feature-level scheduling and standalone or stacked delivery topology are separate: functional order and cross-repository dependencies remain standalone, while only a true same-repository code dependency can justify a stack. Product-level contradictions return to the user rather than relaunching Feature planning automatically. Implement consumes exact-head provider readiness from G's delivery-status workflow, maps Git and GitHub transport to G-owned workflows, gates stacked children on a green exact-HEAD parent, reconciles parent drift, and keeps a minimal SQLite WAL recovery ledger. Provider automation and bypass capabilities never authorize Implement to merge, enqueue, or change auto-merge state. An explicit SE2 GitHub request implicitly authorizes the exact in-scope hosted writes required by its selected workflow; merge, deploy, release, and post-merge closure remain outside the default scope. Audit observes active SE2 sessions read-only, reconstructs workflow-graph conformance from positive evidence, and reports feedback, bugs, regressions, graph violations, and graph-design improvements without persistent state. Root contracts standardize graph vocabulary, live task preflight, optional delegation and goal capability observations, destination and identity observation, bounded display-title reconciliation, update relay, and recovery.
defaultPrompt: Use $se2:learn for durable repository knowledge or $se2:idea for transient capture and explicit GitHub publication.

Use $se2:feature for an explicit Feature Plan Set run with optional read-only analysts, an independent critic, and one consolidated question batch; publish genuinely distinct sibling Features and each local closed macro-vertical Task projection by default without creating a container or deriving technical execution units.

Use $se2:implement to interpret authoritative Feature Plan Sets, schedule Feature dependencies, create an orchestrator and one Feature Worker/PR per eligible Feature, optionally use bounded delegated support when available, and return verified per-Feature PR delivery, or use $se2:audit to monitor SE2 graph runs read-only.
